INSPECTION OF AIR FLOW METER

Check that the honey-combed mesh is neither deformed nor damaged.
If necessary, replace the air flow meter.

INSTALLATION OF AIR FLOW METER

1. INSTALL AIR FLOW METER
(a) Install the air cleaner cap, No.1 air cleaner cover and lock plates to the air flow meter with the four nuts.
(b) Pry the lock plates on the nuts.

(c) Install the bracket with the two screws.

2. INSTALL AIR FLOW METER WITH AIR CLEANER CAP
(a) Install the air flow meter with air cleaner cap, and tighten the clamp.
